name: System Settings
author: TurnOver
summary: System Settings: commands for the sidebar, current pane and search, with clearer button labels. Preview.
description: Command-Control-1 moves to the sidebar, 2 to the current pane and 3 to search. When native focus is unavailable, TurnOver announces a verified review-cursor fallback. Normal navigation and editing keys keep their native behavior. Turn it on in Applications to try it.
privacy: Reads System Settings on your Mac; nothing is sent anywhere.

changes.notes: Add guarded part navigation and bounded optional attributed button labels.
